infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BFAM uses your location to show turfs near you in Discover.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: BFAM checks your contacts' phone numbers against registered players so you can invite people you know. Only phone numbers are sent, never names or other contact details.
